page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, which supports high-throughput network communication and efficient data transfer between instances and external services. No graphics processing units are bundled with this configuration.

The ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for enterprise applications that require a steady ratio of compute power to memory. Its dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This configuration is appropriate for workloads such as medium-to-large databases, web serving, application servers, enterprise resource planning systems, and general-purpose containerized deployments.
